For each compound, an eight-point dose response experiment was carried out using a concentration range of 50–2000 μM, 5–200 μM or 0.0625–2.5 μM, depending on the potency of the compound. KD values were calculated from the background normalized binding curve generated from the sensorgrams under equilibrium conditions, using the 1:1 binding model in the Biacore software version 2 (GE Life Sciences, Amersham Place, UK). All results are reported as the geometric mean ± standard error of the mean (SEM) of at least three independent measurements unless otherwise stated.
